hue_agreement.method: whole-frame signalstats HUEAVG (coarse proxy; wreath is a small ROI)
hue_agreement.note: both arms drift similarly; the A-vs-B gap (4.5 on 0-360) is within noise

invented_wreath_elements.A_long: none — dried golden-brown, narrow lanceolate leaves, no fresh-green, no fabricated closed ring
invented_wreath_elements.B_short: none — same; dried golden-brown, narrow leaves, faithful

verdict: NO MEASURABLE DIFFERENCE. The 65-word motion-only prompt held the kotinos fidelity as well as the 261-word CONTINUITY block. The keyframe drove the fidelity (GenHQ 'frames drive the output'), so the long invariant-restatement is REDUNDANT — not harmful, but not earning its length.
recommendation: Adopt the brief Kling motion format (motion + one hold line, ~40-65 words). Since B matches A at 1/4 the words and is GenHQ-correct, this supports the per-model motion-emitter change. CAVEAT: n=1 per arm (stochastic generation) — the direction is clear (redundant, not harmful) but a 3x-each repeat would harden it if wanted before changing the emitter.
